about.text: A cold drink of cachaça and condensed milk with cocoa or chocolate and spices such as cinnamon and cloves, from Cachoeira do Arari in Pará, Brazil. It is blended or shaken with ice and served in small cups, and it is linked to the São Sebastião festival and to Carnival.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
